name: Beach Village at The Del
insider_take: This exclusive beachfront enclave sits on the legendary Hotel del Coronado grounds, where Hollywood royalty once played and the ghost of Kate Morgan still roams the historic halls.
whats_special: Beach Village offers ultra-luxury oceanfront cottages and villas with private patios just steps from the same pristine sands where "Some Like It Hot" was filmed. You're staying within America's largest wooden Victorian structure, a National Historic Landmark that's hosted 11 U.S. presidents and countless celebrities since 1888.
pro_tip: Book a ground-floor villa for direct beach access, and time your stay during winter months when gray whales migrate past Coronado's shores—you can spot them right from your private patio.
dont_miss: The Crown Room's legendary Sunday brunch where L. Frank Baum conceived the Emerald City after being inspired by the hotel's sparkling chandeliers, and sunset cocktails at Babcock & Story Bar, named after the hotel's original architects who built this seaside masterpiece without a single nail.
pros: Direct beachfront access to pristine Coronado Beach
Spacious villa-style accommodations with full kitchens
Connected to iconic Hotel del Coronado amenities and dining
Family-friendly resort with multiple pools and activities
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury beachfront location
Popular destination requires advance booking during peak seasons
